title: Solid Lipid Nanoparticles (SLNs) for Intracellular Targeting Applications
protocol: Use aseptic technique to prepare sub-20 nm SLNs.
Combine 0.6 mg of fluorescent dye (Nile Red) and 0.10 g of Heneicosane into a vial, co-melt at 90 °C, and stir.
Add 0.11 g polyoxyethylene (10) oleyl ether to the mixture, co-melt at 90 °C, and stir.
Heat to 90 °C and add 1.79 g of sterile water, stirring until a transparent nanoemulsion is formed.
Prepare a control sample by combining 0.10 g of Heneicosane and 0.11 g polyoxyethylene (10) oleyl ether into a vial, co-melt at 90 °C, and stir.
Heat to 90 °C and add 1.79 g of sterile water, stirring until a transparent nanoemulsion is formed.
Sterilize each nanoemulsion using a sterile 0.2 µm filter.
Use dynamic light scattering to measure the particle size and polydispersity of the SLNs.
Fill the glass cuvette with 1.5 ml of standard solution and measure the standard solution using the same measurement conditions as the samples.
Measure the samples as prepared using a run time of 100 sec, refractive index of water (1.33), and viscosity of water at 20 °C (1.002 mPa·sec).
Use a differential scanning calorimeter equipped with an auto-sampler and liquid nitrogen cooling source to investigate the thermal behavior of SLNs.
Pipette as-prepared SLNs into a 40 µl aluminum pan with a mass of approximately 25 mg.
Hermetically seal the pan using a universal crimper press to minimize moisture loss during DSC scan.
Measure each nanoemulsion from 5 to 80 °C.
Report the melting point and the latent heat of melting from the DSC plot, where the valley represents the melting point.
Calculate the latent heat of melting by dividing the integral of the area under the curve in the DSC plot by the amount of material.
Culture primary human fibroblasts according to manufacturer’s instructions in liquid medium for human dermal fibroblasts (medium 106), supplemented with low serum growth supplement (LSGS) kit.
Maintain cells in a humidified atmosphere at 37 °C, 5% CO2 and subculture upon reaching 80% confluence.
Seed cells in a 96-well plate at a density of 2 x 10^4 cells per well and allow to equilibrate at 37 °C O/N prior to SLN exposure.
At time zero, dilute SLNs in complete medium as indicated with respect to lipid concentration and add 10 μl per well to each replicate well in the 96-well plate.
Maintain cells at 37 °C, 5% CO2 during incubation period.
After 24 hr of incubation with SLNs, determine cellular viability using MTT assay according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Wash cells once.
Add fresh medium to each well (100 μl/well).
Kill control wells by incubating in a 70% methanol solution for 10 min before replacing with fresh medium.
Incubate wells overnight at 37 °C after adding MTT reagent (10 μl per well).
Solubilize intracellular formazin crystals with the provided detergent solution (100 μl per well) according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Obtain absorbance values at a measurement wavelength of 570 nm using a microplate reader after incubation at room temperature for 3 hr.
Wash fibroblasts twice with sterile phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Fix fibroblasts for 10 min with cold 70% methanol.
Replace methanol with PBS.
Capture images using an inverted microscope, using a band pass (BP) 690/50 nm filter set.

Plate single cell suspensions of C57BL/10 bone marrow in 100 mm Petri dishes at 2 x 10^6 per plate with recombinant murine granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF, 300 U/ml) and recombinant murine IL-4 (B cell stimulating factor, 200 U/ml).
Change media every 3 days.
Add NiR-loaded SLNs to the dishes at a final concentration of 0.5 and 5.0 μg/ml lipid.
Maintain the cells in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for the desired length of exposure.
Aspirate all media from the plate and collect it in a 50 ml tube.
Wash the plate with 5 ml of PBS containing 4 mM EDTA to dislodge loosely adherent cells.
Collect the cell suspension in the same 50 ml tube.
Determine the concentration of the cell suspension obtained.
Distribute 3x10^5 cells into a 12 mm x 75 mm round bottom FACS tube.
Wash the cells by adding 1 ml of PBS and centrifuge for 5 min at 400 x g, at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 100 μl of PBS/2 mM EDTA/0.1% BSA (staining buffer) containing anti-CD11c-FITC monoclonal antibody (0.25 μg/ml final).
Incubate for 30 min on ice in the dark.
Wash the cells with 1 ml of PBS and then centrifuge the tubes for 5 min at 400 x g, at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend each pellet with 400 μl of staining buffer.
The cells are now ready for acquisition of the samples with a flow cytometer.

Using flow cytometry analysis software, assess the level of incorporation of SLNs by DC by gating on the population of CD11c+ cells (FITC positive) and comparing the intensity of SLNs-associated fluorescence (measured in the PerCP-Cy5.5 or APC channels).
